architecture.job_granularity: Complete fit, replica, chain or validation job, rather than individual predictions or quadrature nodes
julia_responsibilities: parameter transformations and transversity/Collins input parametrizations
evolution-operator application and parameter-dependent evolution where required
SIDIS, SIA, hadron-in-jet and tensor-moment numerical adapters
quadrature, residuals, nuisance profiling, chi-square and normalized likelihood
validated derivatives, multistart optimization and uncertainty calculations
python_responsibilities: source retrieval, data normalization, validation receipts and reports
Snakemake dependency, resource, retry and update orchestration
legacy Python reference programs in isolated validation jobs
architecture.symbolic_responsibilities: Keep FeynFacet Wolfram/Mathematica and existing toolchain; version numerical coefficient exports for Julia

proposed_job_contract.input: Versioned JSON specification plus non-executable array artifacts with explicit dtype, shape, units and hashes
proposed_job_contract.output: Predictions, fit or validation arrays and a fresh atomic JSON receipt
proposed_job_contract.status: Complete Julia job CLI implemented for finite-kernel synthetic closure; production admission blocked
proposed_job_contract.scope_policy: Require explicit matching synthetic_closure scopes in job/data/kernel; reject production and missing/unsupported scopes before numerical dispatch.

architecture.precision: Float64 reference; complex arithmetic where Mellin inversion requires it; reduced precision only after separate validation
environment_lock_requirements: Fortran compiler, flags, BLAS and bridge build hash
architecture.parallelism: Process-isolated legacy Fortran contexts by default; audit mutable SAVE state before sharing one library across Julia threads; cap BLAS/OpenMP threads per Snakemake job

fortran_policy.development_location: Project-owned bridges and source-locked runtime builds; keep the pinned upstream reference unchanged

module_actions.reason: Retain the compiled evolution solver and stepper as a numerical reference; replacement requires profiling evidence and equivalence checks
Retain existing grid, endpoint and distribution handling; Julia may apply an exported operator without reimplementing its construction
Retain coupling, threshold and special-function behavior under the selected physics contract

module_actions.work: Reuse pre-evolution and grid setup, build or export fixed evolution operators, batch initial distributions and evaluations, and reuse work buffers after profiling
module_actions.qualification: The reconstructed scalar kernel and batched bridge retain upstream construction. Query-bound row exports are under physical-input validation; the global-grid source-knot pilot remains failed and is not production admitted.

module_actions.work: Add a narrow ISO_C_BINDING/bind(C) bridge with explicit shapes, ownership, errors and context isolation; do not pass AD dual numbers to a Float64 ABI
module_actions.qualification: The current streamlined interface has module SAVE state; concurrent shared-context calls are not assumed safe

module_actions.missing_source: KPSY15 author-modified HOPPET and original fitting program have not been located
module_actions.work: Implement the paper-defined transversity kernels, chosen Collins collinear evolution approximation and their Julia operator adapters as reconstruction, with independent analytic and numerical checks
module_actions.qualification: Do not identify upstream polarized evolution with the missing transversity modification, or reuse a transversity kernel for Collins evolution without justification

module_actions.trigger: A measured hotspot or required unsupported derivative remains after cache, batching and allocation improvements
module_actions.work: Replace only the isolated hotspot behind the same API; retain the original backend for A/B validation and rollback
module_actions.acceptance: G2, G2AD, G2PERF and G3 must pass; record either a measured end-to-end benefit or a documented derivative/maintenance benefit within the frozen performance budget

fortran_policy.compiler_policy: Record optimization flags; do not enable fast-math or reduced precision by default; validate any reassociation or precision change separately

evolution_derivatives.preferred_route: When the evolution settings are fixed, construct h(Q;theta)=U(Q,Q0)h0(theta) and apply U in generic Julia arithmetic
evolution_derivatives.parameter_dependent_operator: If any operator setting is fitted, include (dU/dtheta)*h0 using a validated sensitivity or derivative implementation; never silently stop that gradient or freeze the operator
evolution_derivatives.fallback: A foreign-function operation must supply and validate backend-compatible derivative rules; finite differences can be a named reference or temporary optimizer route, not misreported as AD
evolution_derivatives.higher_order: First-order custom rules do not establish Hessian support; validate Hessian-vector products independently before covariance uses them

automatic_differentiation.initial_candidate: ForwardDiff for the small-parameter generic Julia implementation
other_candidates: appropriate reverse-mode backend after mutation and API compatibility checks
automatic_differentiation.backend_selection: Compare correctness, gradient wall time and allocation on the same parameter fixtures; no unmeasured winner
automatic_differentiation.foreign_code: ForwardDiff does not automatically differentiate Fortran; Enzyme differentiation of foreign source requires a compatible LLVM/compiler route or explicit rules, not merely a compiled shared library
automatic_differentiation.quadrature: Use validated fixed nodes for the optimizer where suitable; compare against independent adaptive/high-precision integration and node refinement
automatic_differentiation.type_policy: Parametrizations, buffers and arithmetic must accept AD-compatible numeric types; isolate fixed Float64 foreign calls outside the differentiable operator application

validation.policy: Pilot calibration is explicit and versioned; production gates use a frozen policy hash; an agent cannot relax a failed gate

coverage: SIDIS, SIA, STAR 200/510 and lattice moments
nuisance and parameter-dependent covariance when used
fixtures.parameter_coordinates: Dimensionless unconstrained coordinates with fixed documented scales/transforms; include the transform Jacobian in all derivatives
fixtures.data_status: Fixtures require normalized data or explicitly labeled analytic/synthetic cases; none are claimed executed here

physics.point_rule: Both bounds must hold for available experimental bins; zero-sigma or non-data fixtures need explicit observable-specific bounds
checks: same-contract Fortran/Julia or independent-route predictions
grid, scale-step and quadrature convergence
analytic kernel moments and independent x-space/Mellin evolution in matching domains
spin signs, flavor order, z and mass factors, units and bin integration
selected-order Soffer treatment and input constraints
tensor-charge moments including scale dependence, never spurious charge conservation
Collins evolution approximation explicitly separate from transversity
cache reuse versus clean recomputation after changing every dependency
physics.baseline_qualification: KPSY15 is a reconstruction until the missing code is recovered; do not require JAM Gaussian/log-log predictions to equal a CSS model

gradients.comparison: abs(d_AD-d_ref) <= atol + rtol*max(abs(d_AD),abs(d_ref)) in scaled coordinates
gradients.finite_difference_requirement: Require a stable step-size plateau and a numerical integration error budget small enough for the derivative test; failure to resolve a plateau is not a pass
checks: component and randomized directional derivatives of predictions and objective
independent AD backends where supported
U linearity, JVP/VJP directional checks and adjoint dot-product identity
gradients after quadrature and evolution-grid refinement
nuisance profiling and covariance normalization derivatives when applicable
Hessian-vector finite differences and symmetry if covariance uses a Hessian
gradients.boundaries: Use interior points or smooth unconstrained transforms; invalid-domain inputs must fail explicitly rather than be clipped into misleading derivatives

workloads: operator construction and cache-hit application separately
replica throughput at fixed core count
posterior ESS per second if Bayesian mode is enabled
controls: same physics contract, data, parameters, tolerance, precision and seed
same hardware, compiler and BLAS settings
record cold start, package loading, JIT, I/O and warm execution separately
limit nested Julia/BLAS/OpenMP threads under Snakemake resources
separate same-algorithm language comparison from precomputation/algorithm improvements
performance.comparison_baseline: Retained same-contract reference or uncached implementation; use Python only if physics and accuracy match; unavailable baselines remain N/A
performance.regression_rule: Proposed 10% regression budget versus an established accepted baseline; freeze workload-specific time and memory limits after pilot. First implementation needs a calibrated absolute budget, not a fictitious speedup
performance.full_fit_followup: After G4, report end-to-end multistart/replica runtime and final fit agreement; a fast isolated kernel is insufficient evidence

checks: noise-free recovery and noisy pseudoexperiment coverage
misspecified-model and endpoint stress cases
same-data multistart agreement including alternate minima
backend changes preserve predictions, objective and physical moments within frozen numerical/statistical budgets
replica distribution or posterior agreement within sampling uncertainty rather than identical random trajectories
B3/B4 lattice pair and process holdouts retain original interpretation
